NnapiExecutionProvider.policy: Probe on the actual Fold only. NNAPI CPU devices are disabled; unsupported partitions may run in ORT CPU and must be reported. Provider registration is not proof of NPU execution.
NnapiExecutionProvider.androidStatus: NNAPI deprecated since Android 15/API 35; not a promised forward-compatible performance path

QNNExecutionProvider.policy: Only consider after identifying a supported Qualcomm SoC, obtaining the vendor SDK under its own terms, and building a separate verified ORT backend. Do not infer support from Samsung branding. No vendor library is bundled.

SamsungNeuralSDK.policy: Samsung's official download notice says this SDK is no longer provided to third-party developers. No private API or system model extraction is supported.

galaxyAiFoundationModels.policy: No Galaxy AI model access is claimed. Android AICore/ML Kit GenAI is a separate Google API/model contract and is not a replacement for the pinned Lik profiles.

acceleratorAcceptance.scope: every enabled pipeline in the exact profile, on the exact model artifacts, device firmware, driver and runtime build
requiredEvidence: device model, SoC, Android API, build fingerprint, NNAPI driver name/version, runtime library SHA-256 and provider options
catalog SHA-256, pipeline fingerprint, all model/tokenizer hashes and fixture manifest SHA-256
per-model session creation and full pipeline self-test, finite outputs and exact shapes
paired CPU/accelerator outputs on all fixed RU/EN image/text/OCR/face fixtures; maximum absolute error, cosine drift, ranked retrieval changes, OCR text changes and face decision changes
per-operator/partition assigned execution provider, unsupported operator names/reasons and CPU fallback counts; unavailable profiling is a failed capability claim
cold session/load latency, warm p50/p95 latency with sample count, total pipeline latency including copies and tokenization, peak process PSS/native/Java memory
at least 10 minutes of sustained indexing with timestamped thermal status, charging/battery state, throughput, cancellation and foreground responsiveness
written acceptance against explicit per-pipeline tolerances, and recovery to the CPU reference on session/driver/self-test failure
acceleratorAcceptance.numericPolicy: Set tolerances before a run. Identical FP32/INT8 artifacts start with atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-3 and embedding cosine >=0.999; failing a tolerance cannot be fixed by silently relaxing it. Reduced precision requires a new reviewed backend configuration and task-quality evaluation.
acceleratorAcceptance.enablePolicy: Runtime opt-in may enable only an accepted evidence fingerprint; model, OS, driver or runtime changes invalidate acceptance. No Task 9 emulator/host smoke or absent metric can enable an accelerator. CPU-only completion does not depend on accelerator availability.
